prompt: RimWorld creature sprite, side view, flat cel-shaded vanilla-RimWorld toy-figurine art style: the Star Wars canon Fanback — a large, cold-blooded amphibian predator with a tall sail-like dorsal spine fan running the length of its back, a long sensitive snout, a squat sprawling four-legged posture, mottled damp grey-green hide.
